items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: He had one and so he left it there. He said, play that, you can play that tonight.

ctx.x: What make did you like? Oh, I think, uh, that was, uh, I believe I made, uh, made, uh, had a trumpet then of, uh, was made here in Chicago. Jay, Harry B. Jay. Oh, yeah. A cornet. I've heard, yeah, let's say Armstrong used one of those. Yes, yeah. It was a cornet. It was a cornet, yeah. I, I, uh, uh, the reason I bought that, uh, Jay, there was, uh, I was working with Jimmy Newton. I was working with Jimmy Newton on 35th Street at night, uh, after hour. Yeah. Nightclub. And, uh, Muggsy used to come in. Oh, yeah.…

I was going to get a new trumpet and he mentioned about the J. He had one and so he left it there. He said, play that, you can play that tonight. He came in and left his horn there and he left, came back a little later. And so I blew that J and I liked it. So I went down that week I think and bought a J. And I kept that horn until I still have it. It's no good but it's still...
It was a cornet, not a trumpet. Cornet, yeah. You used that about that time.
